neighbours.label: phrases of keeping a harm away or being free of it ('at bay', 'disease free', 'avoids', 'keeps ... out')
fire: A daily walk helps keep stress and heart trouble at bay.
The orchard stayed pest free thanks to the netting we installed.
Garlic is said to keep mosquitoes at bay on summer nights.
Proper storage keeps the flour mold free for many months.
A strong firewall keeps most intruders at bay.
The new filter keeps the water clean and bacteria free all year.
Wearing a mask in the workshop avoids breathing in fine dust.
Regular pruning keeps fungal disease at bay in the rose bed.
quiet: A daily walk is a pleasant way to spend the early evening.
The orchard produced a large crop thanks to the warm spring.
Garlic adds a strong flavor to soups on cold winter nights.
Proper storage keeps the flour in a dry cupboard near the oven.
A strong firewall is part of the network the company bought.
The new filter makes the coffee taste smoother in the morning.
Wearing a mask in the workshop is part of the safety training.
Regular pruning gives the rose bed a neat shape in the summer.

notes: card: ' free' (disease free), ' bay' (at bay), ' avoids', ' risk'; probe: 'at bay' 0.67, 'weed free' 0.27, 'avoid' 0.21
